messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: PD#12345 fired for node gpu-node-17 (host/gpu-17). Reason: kernel OOPS and kubelet NotReady. Auto-escalation initiated.
pagerduty: PagerDuty: alert routed to eng-oncall escalation policy. Initial ack window started.
sam: acked — I'm on this. grabbing serial console now.
ops-bot: Automated check: host reachable via IP? false. SSH attempt failed: Connection timed out.
maria: I'm running quick incident impact check — which tenants on gpu-node-17?
arjun: @maria looks like 2 Dedicated tenants + ephemeral workloads. pulling pods: `kubectl get pods --all-namespaces -o wide --field-selector spec.nodeName=gpu-node-17`
sam: serial logs coming in, repeating oops trace every ~2 mins. suspect driver or hw fault. snippet: ```kernel: NMI: kernel oops: GPU reset failed at gpu_reset+0x1f/0x40```.
arjun: kubelet is flapping NotReady; node object shows: `Conditions: Ready=False (KubeletNotReady)` and `LastHeartbeatTime` stale.
maria: Customer impact: Dedicated customer 'helium-ai' has 3 pods evicted; their latency SLO likely impacted for batch inference. flagging to CSM.
sam: trying soft-reboot via IPMI to see if kubelet recovers — running `ipmitool chassis power cycle`.
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert escalated to level 2 after no ack by primary for 5m. Paging next oncall.
arjun: @sam if reboot doesn't fix, plan: cordon & drain node, failover their Dedicated workload to reserved pool (reserved-dedicated-2). I'll prep capacity.
sam: IPMI returned power cycle success but host not back on serial yet. continuing poll.
ops-bot: BMC indicates boot started. Serial present but kernel hits same oops during boot at 2nd init.
maria: Notifying CSM: "Helium AI — we detected node kernel oops and we are failing their jobs to another reserved pool. Engineers are on it." (DM sent).
kate: jumping in — I'm taking ownership from sam. kate is the oncall now. @sam handing off: serial logs, BMC cycle done, oops persists.
sam: handing off to @kate — I've documented commands run in incident channel.
kate: thanks — I'm going to cordon now so scheduler doesn't keep putting pods there. `kubectl cordon gpu-node-17`
arjun: I'll start live relocation: `kubectl drain gpu-node-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force` — doing it in batches to avoid eviction storms.
incident-bot: Alert note: drain command started by arjun at 1729456920.
kate: drain progress: 12/14 pods evicted, 2 stuck (helm-managed jobs). investigating stuck pods: one stuck on preStop hook.
arjun: forcing eviction for stuck pods with grace 30s. `kubectl delete pod <pod> --grace-period=30 --force`
maria: Helium AI reported spike in inference errors at 1729456935, now degraded but failing over. updating status page: "Investigating degraded inference for helium-ai. Engineers working on failover."
sam: ops note: NVMe SMART for gpu-17 shows high corrected errors on controller A. possible hardware RMA. saving logs.
kate: failover complete for Dedicated tenant workloads — all critical pods rescheduled to reserved-dedicated-2. Confirmed via Cilium flow checks.
maria: informing support & CSM: failover done, monitoring for errors, probable hardware RMA for host.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert acknowledged by kate at 1729456970. Escalation halted.
kate: next steps: open RMA ticket with hw team, schedule maintenance window to reimage host once replaced. tagging eng-infra.
arjun: I'll add a temporary routing policy to avoid gpu-17 in autoscaling pools until marked healthy: `service-routing exclude: gpu-node-17`
sam: ps: check for autoscaler churn — we saw a small spike in scale-up when pods couldn't land; scaling back now.
maria: Customer comms drafted: "Hi helium-ai — we detected host-level hardware errors and failed your workload to a reserved pool to preserve SLAs. Engineers are arranging hardware replacement; we'll update in 1 hour." sending now.
kate: monitoring logs and kube events for 15m. setting follow-up oncall for 1729460389 (in 1 hour) to confirm RMA/bringup. handing off to arjun for next shift.
arjun: ack — I'll own the RMA coordination and postmortem. adding runbook notes about nvme-corrected-error bump detection to reduce time-to-RMA.
incident-bot: Incident summary saved to /incidents/1729456789 in the internal tracker.
maria: recording customer impact: helium-ai affected, ~10 minutes of degraded service, failover succeeded, no data loss.
kate: closing pager for now. final check: node still NotReady, labelling host `rma_needed=true`.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert resolved by kate at 1729457025.
